query:
SELECT c.id AS "id: ClientId"
                FROM client_webauthn_origins o
                JOIN oidc_clients c ON c.id = o.client_id
                WHERE o.origin = $1
                AND c.enabled
                AND c.trusted
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM oidc_redirect_uris r
                    WHERE r.client_id = c.id
                    AND r.kind = 'authorization'
                    AND r.origin = o.origin
                )
